supersedes.why: S159: the inherited percentile range excluded the point for 7 metrics

acceptance_rule: [point - (median - q05), point + (q95 - median)] over the donor resamples; the inherited percentile range is kept beside it for every metric
comparison_protocol: score a synthetic world on the stratum's own universe AND on the stratum's own number of cells; correlation-magnitude statistics depend on n

rule.stratum: smallest cohort coverage containing every detection of the cell, over all addresses; donor-level majority used
rule.eligibility: at least two classes with >= 200 cells (frozen T5 floor)
rule.universe: detected in more than 5% of the stratum's cells (frozen floor)
rule.genes: 3000 by CPM-log1p expression variance within the stratum (frozen rule)
rule.envelope: donor bootstrap within stratum, 24 replicates, seed 20261006, gene set held at the point estimate's, range = quantiles (0.05, 0.95)

NPH52.reason: fewer than two classes with >= 200 cells
